links.comparator_used: No update (unchanged retinal AI system), plus flag-all and flag-none policies
links.outcome: Image-level Brier loss, patient-level detection, positive flags and net benefit at threshold probabilities 0.05-0.30
links.effect: At audit budget 200, mean Brier loss improved in all eight cohort-system comparisons. In mBRSET, missed positives fell from 51-133 to 2-14 per 1,000 patients. At p=0.20 in mBRSET, all four updates exceeded flag all but remained below no update. In DeepDRiD at p=0.20, the APTOS update increased mean net benefit by 0.0510 over no update and exceeded both simple policies.
links.tradeoff: In mBRSET, flags rose from 154-442 to 809-951 per 1,000 patients, which is 5.69-9.48 additional flags per additional detection. At p=0.05, three of four updates had lower mean net benefit than flag all.
links.quote: Image-level improvement did not ensure patient-level benefit.

design_hint: local recalibration and operating threshold selection
